title: The dark note
starting_code:
# One move in this program is wrong. Find it and fix it!
wizard.move_left()
wizard.move_left()
wizard.move_down()
wizard.move_right()
hints: Read the note at the top to see what to do. One of the lines takes us the wrong way!
The first three steps are correct. Where does the path go after that?
intro: I wrote a program for this next bit of the path, but one of the moves is wrong and takes us the wrong way! Can you read my note and fix the code?
outro: Thank you for fixing my code! Notes like that really help us remember what to do.
learned: Now you know what a comment is, and that a note in a program can tell you what to do.
